messages:
Maya: Heads-up — last night's role cleanup in staging seems to have broken DAST login. Nightly run failed at 00:12 with a 401 from the auth service. Anyone oncall?
Samir: Oof. saw the alert. Which credential is DAST using in staging?
Maya: It uses the ephemeral service token stored in secret `staging/dast/sa-token`, decrypted via KMS key `sdlc-dast-key`.
deploy-bot: deploy infra/roles @alex completed (PR #482) — removed deprecated role `staging-dast-legacy` at 2026-03-20T23:45Z :rocket:
Alex: that was me — I removed the old role as part of the privilege tidy-up. Did we update the DAST service account bindings?
Maya: Not that I can see. DAST job started but auth returned `401` -> `invalid_token`.
Samir: Can anyone grep audit logs for KMS decrypt failures? Might be a key rotation too.
Leo: grabbing logs now.
Leo: pastebin of filtered logs: 
```
2026-03-21T00:11:58Z audit: projects/xyz/locations/global/keyRings/sdlc/cryptoKeys/sdlc-dast-key: cryptoKeyVersions/3: decrypt: PERMISSION_DENIED
2026-03-21T00:12:01Z iam: serviceAccount:dast-svc@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com: denied iam.serviceAccounts.get
```
Maya: That decrypt PERMISSION_DENIED looks like KMS key version rotated (v3) but IAM binding not applied to the CI principal.
Samir: Confirmed — PR #482 included rotation and removed the `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` binding from the old CI principal when consolidating roles. I thought DAST used a different principal though.
Alex: My bad — I assumed the DAST job used the `staging-ci` principal. It uses `dast-runner`. I didn't update that one.
Maya: Ok we have two immediate options: 1) re-add the decrypter binding to `dast-runner` (fast fix), or 2) revert last infra change (safer for audits if we need a clean rollback). Thoughts?
Samir: For incident containment, re-adding the KMS IAM binding is fastest. But we should record the change in the audit ticket.
security-bot: Security checklist reminder: Any KMS/IAM change must be accompanied by an audit annotation + approval in Jira ticket SEC-1307.
Leo: I'll re-add the binding now and post logs. Doing: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding sdlc-dast-key --member=serviceAccount:dast-runner@... --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`
Leo: ...done. KMS decrypt errors stopped within ~30s. Nightly DAST restarted and progressed past login.
Maya: Nightly run now shows scans continuing, but SAST pre-merge hooks failing on a new rule — unrelated but surfaced by the flush of jobs.
Alex: About the SAST false positive we saw yesterday — I proposed suppression label in repo, but we need to make suppression visible in audit logs (compliance asked). Any objections to adding `sast:accepted-fp` label and capturing reviewer in block comment?
Samir: That works. But require a checklist item: who reviewed + link to the eval case in the ticket. We should also ensure suppressions are recorded in the keystore audit (we store suppression approvals in `sec-audit` bucket).
Maya: Agreed. Action items: (1) Leo re-added KMS binding and log posted, (2) Alex to update infra PR to include `dast-runner` permissions and add a note linking SEC-1307, (3) Samir to open a suppression audit entry for the SAST false positive.
Alex: I'll open PR to explicitly grant `dast-runner` the decrypter role and add an entry in infra/README about rotation impacts. PR -> #491.
Samir: I'll create SEC-1312 for the suppression audit and attach CI evidence + reviewer sign-off.
Maya: One more thing: should we pause automated nightly scans until infra role cleanup completes? We might get noisy alerts.
Samir: Don't pause — instead add a temporary circuit breaker in the DAST job that retries with exponential backoff and alerts only if consecutive auth failures > 3. Less blind spots and fewer noisy tickets.
Leo: I'll add a retry wrapper to the job script and a metric `dast.auth.failures` to Sentry/console.
Maya: Thanks all. I'll update the incident ticket with timeline and remediation steps. Closing here once PR #491 and SEC-1312 exist. :thumbsup:
